subsystem.name: PlatformAbstraction
subsystem.responsibility: CPU/OS capability detection performed during platform startup; probes instruction-set feature flags and feeds the results to higher-level feature selection.

summary: A single CPU capability probe, CPUID3DNowDetection (0x0050FD16), queries the maximum extended CPUID leaf with EAX = 0x80000000, and when extended leaf 0x80000001 is available issues CPUID with that leaf and reports whether bit 31 of EDX (the 3DNow! support flag) is set. It returns 0 when the extended leaf is unsupported. It is invoked by OSVersionDetection (0x0050FDF3) during OS/CPU capability detection. The packet resolves only this one probe; the surrounding detection framework and any consumption of the reported flag are not in scope.

function_roles.role: CPU 3DNow! capability probe: queries CPUID extended leaves 0x80000000/0x80000001 and returns the EDX bit 31 3DNow! support flag as a BOOL, or 0 when the extended leaf is unavailable.

classes.name: CpuCapabilityProbe
classes.responsibility: Query CPU instruction-set capability flags via CPUID and report them for platform feature selection. DERIVED grouping; the packet records the owner type as UnknownObject, so this class name is a reconstruction, not an original symbol.

compatibility_contracts.name: Cpu3DNowCapabilityReport
compatibility_contracts.description: During OS/CPU capability detection a replacement executable must determine whether the CPU supports 3DNow! (CPUID extended leaf 0x80000001, EDX bit 31) and expose that result so higher-level feature selection can consume it. The probe must return 0 when extended CPUID is unsupported.
